setting: a pastel tropical island: pale sand, mint-green grass tufts, salmon-pink palm trunks with mint fronds, dark gray boulders, stone nest pedestals holding pale eggs, shallow turquoise water and a white-blue sky under soft light

subjects.desc: the protagonist: a petite thief with short pink hair, a white blouse, dark shorts and white sneakers, seen from behind
a patrolling guard in a dark uniform and cap, walking a set route around the egg nests

sound: gentle surf, gulls, footsteps on sand
